items.t: HSBC Downgrades XPeng to Hold, Announces $10.1 Price Target
items.sum: HSBC analyst Yuqian Ding downgrades XPeng (NYSE:XPEV) from Buy to Hold and announces $10.1 price target.

items.t: XPeng: A Great Asset To Conquer European Market By 2030
items.sum: Xpeng (XPEV) is a solid buy as general break-even approaches and profitability could make the stock too cheap to ignore.

items.t: XPeng Stock Down 52% YTD: Is This a Buying Opportunity?
items.sum: XPeng shares have plunged 52% YTD, but rising deliveries and improving vehicle margins face stiff competition, high costs and a valuation premium.

items.t: XPeng's Q4 Delivery Growth Outlook Faces a Bigger Margin Test
items.sum: XPeng targets 45%-50% delivery growth in Q4'26, but a shift toward lower-priced models raises margin concerns despite strong overseas sales prospects.
